title: Exploratory Analysis of the Effects of Thymoquinone Alone and in Combination with 5-Fluorouracil on Inflammatory Mediators in Colorectal Cancer Cells: An In Vitro and In Silico Study.
snippet: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide. Chronic inflammation plays a pivotal role in CRC development and progression, with cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and interleukin-8 (IL-8) representing key mediators of tumor-promoting inflammation.
